meta.name: oh-my-issues
meta.description: Cluster a GitHub issue backlog by root cause into a small set of plan-master issues, redirect children with a standardized comment, and bundle architectural-fix PRs that close clusters atomically. Use when an issue tracker has accumulated dozens of reports that share underlying defects, when asked to triage / consolidate / cluster / dedupe issues, when asked to build a plan series or roadmap from open issues, or when routing a new incoming bug into an existing plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub issue 按根因聚类为计划，自动重定向子问题并打包修复 PR
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 issue 列表里堆满了重复报告，想按根因统一治理
copy.tagline_en: Cluster GitHub issues by root cause into plans, redirect children, and bundle fix PRs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your issue tracker is cluttered with duplicate reports and you want to consolidate by root cause

howto.what: 它把仓库里的 GitHub issue 按同一根本原因归组，每组建一个 plan 主 issue 并写一份 plans/0X-*.md 设计文档，子 issue 用统一话术关闭为 not planned，再用一个 PR 一次性关掉整组子 issue。
howto.when: 当仓库未关闭 issue 达到 20 条以上且疑似同源重复，或你要求 triage、consolidate、cluster 等整理动作，或想把新报的 bug 归入已有计划时接管。

say.text: 把这批 issue 按根本原因聚类，每组开一个 plan 主 issue
say.note: 会先读完每个 issue 的正文和评论再分组

howto.what_en: Clusters a GitHub issue backlog by root cause, opens one plan-master issue plus a plans/0X-*.md design doc per cluster, closes children with a standard redirect as 'not planned', and ships one PR that closes the whole cluster.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a repo has 20+ open issues that look like duplicates, when asked to triage / consolidate / cluster / dedupe issues, or when routing a new bug into an existing plan.

say_en.text: Cluster these issues by root cause and open one plan-master issue per cluster
say_en.note: Reads each issue body and comment thread first

say_en.text: Fold this new bug into an existing plan as a Round N comment on the master
say_en.note: Then closes the child as not planned

say_en.text: This plan is ready to ship - open one PR with Closes #N for every child
